# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_ai_facility.py". Re-run it instead of editing this file.

# Once a year for each AI country of the dwarven culture group (DA_AI_Facility_on_actions.txt).
DA_AI_facility_yearly = {
	# 1. found or expand the Research Facility: the rules of the Expansion button, and a reserve
	if = {
		limit = {
			DA_AM_rf_can_expand = yes
			DA_RF_ai_can_afford = yes
		}
		DA_RF_expand_one_level = yes
	}
	# 2. from level III, a new invention now and then: the reward of a finished Runesmith Research
	if = {
		limit = { DA_has_RF_3_or_higher = yes }
		random = {
			chance = 25
			random_list = {
				10 = { DA_Research_Reward_t1 = yes }
				10 = {
					trigger = { DA_has_RF_6_or_higher = yes adm_tech = 16 }
					DA_Research_Reward_t2 = yes
				}
				10 = {
					trigger = { DA_has_RF_9_or_higher = yes adm_tech = 23 }
					DA_Research_Reward_t3 = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# 3. use the inventions: one off when over capacity, else one on when it fits
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate = estate_da_runesmiths }
		DA_setup_Production_points_system = yes
		DA_Update_production_points = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_is_over_production_points = yes
				DA_AI_has_invention = yes
			}
			DA_AI_drop_invention = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { DA_is_over_production_points = yes }
				DA_AI_can_take_invention = yes
			}
			DA_AI_take_invention = yes
		}
	}
}

# One invention is switched off, the dearest tier first (its on_revoked returns the Production Capacity).
DA_AI_drop_invention = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_IND_PROD_Runic_augmented_uniforms }
		remove_estate_privilege = DA_RS_IND_PROD_Runic_augmented_uniforms
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_estate_privilege = DA_RS_SOC_COURT_Advanced_Runepowered_Filing_System }
